action: Optimize for watch time and DM shares. Make content people want to send to friends, not just like. Track sends per reach in Insights, not just views.
impact: Instagram now ranks primarily on watch time, likes per reach, and sends per reach. Follower counts and raw views matter less. DM shares now outweigh likes for non-follower distribution.
title: Mosseri confirms 3 ranking metrics that matter

action: Make your niche obvious through captions, visuals, and audio. If people can't tell what your topic is in 2 seconds, the algorithm can't either.
impact: Topic preferences set in one surface now apply everywhere. Users who opt out of your topic become harder to reach regardless of engagement strength.
title: 'Your Algorithm' topic controls unified across Feed, Reels, Explore

action: Stop reposting. Every format needs meaningful original creation now, not just Reels. Check Account Status to see if you're flagged.
impact: Accounts posting mostly unoriginal content are excluded from Explore and recommendations. Simple edits like borders or watermarks don't count as original. 75% of US recommendations now come from original posts.
title: Original content protections extended to photos and carousels

action: Create original audio or voiceovers. Strip watermarks before cross-posting. Trending sounds still work for established accounts but hurt small ones.
impact: Reels using recycled or watermarked content get down-ranked. Original audio gets a boost. TikTok watermarks continue to suppress reach.
title: Reels favor original audio over trending sounds

action: Add relevant keywords to every video. Treat TikTok SEO like YouTube SEO now. Cover titles help click-through from search.
impact: Creators can now manually attach custom keywords to videos to improve search visibility, plus a floating Cover Title option. TikTok is doubling down on search as a discovery surface.
title: Custom search keywords for videos

action: Test longer storytelling formats. But completion rate still rules, so only go long if you can hold attention.
impact: Maximum video length raised from 3 to 10 minutes globally, making TikTok competitive with YouTube for longer content.
title: Video duration extended to 10 minutes for all creators

action: Post native, human, niche video. Keep clips tight while completion bar is high. Watch analytics weekly, don't assume last year's playbook works. Avoid AI-generated video as your main format.
impact: TikTok US sold to Oracle/Silver Lake consortium for ~$14B. The For You algorithm is being retrained on US-governed data. Reach instability during transition. Completion rate bar reportedly climbing to ~70% watched. AI-generated video now demoted.
title: US operations sold, algorithm being retrained

action: If you sell anything, make native shopping content. Even affiliate links in Shop-tagged videos get boosted.
impact: Native shopping videos get a distribution edge as the platform blends entertainment with commerce.
title: TikTok Shop content gets algorithmic priority

action: Test 60-90 second Shorts for more depth. But retention math changes, don't pad. 30-45 seconds is still the sweet spot for most niches.
impact: Shorts cap raised from 60 seconds to 3 minutes. Shorts under 60 seconds still qualify for the Shorts feed.
title: Shorts max duration extended to 3 minutes

action: Pick a niche and go deep. Make thumbnails/titles that the content actually delivers on. Use Shorts to funnel into long-form where CPMs are 10-20x higher.
impact: Browse feed now serves micro-niche clusters. Specialists rewarded over generalists. On Shorts, completion and swipe-away speed decide almost everything. CTR and watch time now judged together, clickbait titles get throttled.
title: Shorts and long-form algorithms fully separated

action: Use Shorts for discovery, long-form for revenue. Bridge Shorts viewers into full videos.
impact: YouTube keeps ~55% of Shorts ad revenue, splits remaining 45% among creators by share of monetized views. Long-form still pays significantly better.
title: Shorts monetization via Creator Pool

action: Post when your audience is most active since recency still feeds the prediction. Engagement velocity in the first hour matters more than ever.
impact: The Following feed is now sorted by Grok AI predicted engagement instead of chronological (toggle still available). Grok replaced the legacy recommendation system.
title: Following feed sorted by Grok-predicted engagement

action: Long-form video on X is now viable. Repurpose podcasts and streams.
impact: Premium subscribers can now upload videos up to 4 hours long.
title: Video upload limit raised to 4 hours for Premium

action: Cross-post your Reels to Facebook. It's free reach most people are ignoring.
impact: Facebook Reels distribution increased significantly but most creators aren't posting there.
title: Reels reach up 40%, still underused

action: Post native video on LinkedIn. Under 10 minutes, 16:9, MP4. Huge opportunity for B2B creators.
impact: LinkedIn confirmed native video posts receive significantly more distribution than text or link posts.
title: Native video gets 3x reach of text posts
